title: devx: refusal prose still tells CI to set fetch-depth: 0 where ci.yml now fetches history in a step
body:
domain:devx#2 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTo666XXx9e1Gm21C6

## What

Since #31429 and PR #31644 (card #22034), `ci.yml` checks out at depth 1 and runs the step "Fetch this commit's history and the base branch" in test-plan, test, test-ui and type-check-ui. `ci.yml` no longer has any `fetch-depth:` key. Three shallow-clone refusal messages still tell a CI reader to give the checkout `fetch-depth: 0`:

- `packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas.ts` L2430: "in CI the checkout step needs `fetch-depth: 0`"
- `ui/scripts/check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs` L505: "In CI the checkout needs `fetch-depth: 0`"
- `ui/scripts/check-changeset-claims.mjs` L1424: "In CI, give the checkout `fetch-depth: 0`"

Found by the contract review of PR #31644 (records 6725549004 and 6725813726). It was outside that diff and not graded.

## Fix

Reword each message so that a CI reader is pointed at what works now. In a `ci.yml` job, that is the history fetch step (named by its step name). In a workflow that still checks out full history, such as lint.yml, it is `fetch-depth: 0`. Before rewording, read which workflow runs each script. If a pin asserts the old text, move the pin with it.

## Acceptance

1. None of the three messages names `fetch-depth: 0` as the only CI fix for a job that `ci.yml` runs with the fetch step.
2. Every pin on these messages is green.
